description: This file defines the interface 'ProgressiveLoanTransactionValidator' which extends 'LoanTransactionValidator' and declares methods for validating various aspects of loan transactions related to progressive or capitalized incomes, contract termination, and buy-down fees.

classes.name: ProgressiveLoanTransactionValidator
classes.description: A Java interface extending LoanTransactionValidator, providing method signatures for validating various loan transaction scenarios such as income capitalization and buy-down fees.

methods.name: validateCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Validates the capitalization of income for a given loan based on the provided command.

methods.name: validateCapitalizedIncomeAdjustment
methods.description: Validates adjustments to capitalized income transactions for a specified loan.

methods.name: validateContractTerminationUndo
methods.description: Validates the undo operation of a contract termination for a loan.

methods.name: validateBuyDownFee
methods.description: Validates the buy-down fee transaction for a loan.

methods.name: validateBuyDownFeeAdjustment
methods.description: Validates adjustments to buy-down fee transactions for a specific loan.
